stem: What role did Arkansas governor Orval Faubus play in the Little Rock Crisis?

options.label: F
options.text: He vetoed legislation to establish a separate school system for whites and blacks.

options.label: G
options.text: He challenged the authority of the federal government to desegregate schools.

options.label: H
options.text: He helped minimize race-related violence by establishing integrated advisory groups.

options.label: J
options.text: He refused assistance from the federal government to improve minority graduation rates.
